name: Version number, then the UI retints live
looks: The wordmark settles, then a big version number drops in above an 'out now' tag. It cuts to a headline about making it yours, beside a row of colour swatches with a ring marking the active one; as the ring steps to a new swatch, a real data-table interface beside it retints its accents to match, several times in a row.
build: wordmark-assemble for the logo and version number landing together; command-chip-cycle for the swatch row, the active ring stepping swatch to swatch on the beat; the table UI's accent colour (header badges, selected row) crossfades in lockstep with the ring's position, power2.out.
sound: A soft confirm chime on the version number, then a tick per swatch step with a light colour-shift whoosh on the UI.
prompt: Announce a version, then prove the product is themeable: cycle a row of colour swatches, an indicator ring stepping from one to the next, while a real interface beside it retints its accents to match each choice in lockstep, several times, before settling.
